# Henotic Diagnostics — Full Reference

> Henotic Diagnostics is a NABL-accredited medical diagnostic and imaging center in Kharghar, Navi Mumbai, India. Founded in 2012, it provides 400+ diagnostic imaging, pathology, cardiac diagnostics, health checkup, and NIPT genetic testing services. The center operates 24/7 and is equipped with 3.0 Tesla MRI, 128-slice CT, Digital PET-CT, 4D ultrasound, and automated NABL pathology systems.

## Service Categories (18 Specialties)

### Advanced Imaging
MRI Scan (3.0T), CT Scan (128-slice), [PET-CT Scan](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/pet-ct), SPECT Scan, HRCT Chest, MR Angiography, CT Angiography, CT-guided biopsy, whole-body scans

### Ultrasound & Sonography
Abdominal ultrasound, pelvic ultrasound, obstetric sonography (NT scan, anomaly scan, growth scan), musculoskeletal ultrasound, thyroid ultrasound, breast ultrasound

### Cardiac Diagnostics
2D Echocardiography, ECG, TMT (treadmill test), Holter monitoring (24/48/72-hour), stress echo, ambulatory BP monitoring, cardiac risk assessment

### Doppler Studies
Color Doppler, carotid artery Doppler, renal Doppler, obstetric Doppler, arterial/venous Doppler, DVT scan, peripheral vascular assessment

### Pathology & Blood Tests
CBC, lipid profile, thyroid function, diabetes screening (HbA1c), liver function, kidney function, complete metabolic panel, hormone tests, tumor markers, vitamin panels

### Women's Health & Fertility
Digital mammography, 3D breast tomosynthesis, follicular study, fertility assessment, gynecology ultrasound, HSG test, pelvic scan

### Bone & Liver Health
DEXA bone density scan, BMD test, osteoporosis screening, FibroScan, liver elastography, fatty liver assessment

### Genetic Testing & NIPT Authority Hub
[NIPT Prenatal Screening](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/nipt-test) (Basic Trisomies 21/18/13, Comprehensive genome-wide cfDNA, Advanced microdeletion panels), karyotype analysis, carrier screening, clinical exome & genomic sequencing, microbiome diagnostics

### Health Checkup Packages
[Full Body Checkup](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/full-body-check-up), 17 specialized packages from ₹1,650 (Men, Women, Senior Citizen, Cardiac, Diabetes, Executive screenings)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What services does Henotic Diagnostics offer?**
A: Henotic Diagnostics provides 400+ diagnostic services including blood tests, full-body health checkups (from ₹1,650), advanced imaging (3.0T MRI from ₹4,500, 128-slice CT from ₹4,500, Digital PET-CT from ₹14,500, ultrasound), cardiac diagnostics (2D Echo, ECG), women's health screening (mammography, sonography), and NIPT genetic testing (from ₹10,000).

**Q: Is an MRI scan safe?**
A: Yes, MRI is a non-invasive and radiation-free imaging technique using magnetic fields and radio waves, making it safe for most patients without ionizing radiation.

**Q: How long does a CT or MRI scan take?**
A: CT scans typically take 5–10 minutes on our 128-slice scanner, while 3.0T MRI scans take 20–45 minutes depending on the body region and contrast protocol.

**Q: Do I need a doctor's prescription for imaging tests?**
A: Yes, imaging scans involving radiation or contrast (CT, PET-CT, MRI with contrast) generally require a valid doctor's prescription, while preventive health checkups and routine blood tests can be booked directly.

**Q: How are reports delivered?**
A: Reports are delivered digitally via WhatsApp and email with 99.4% on-time reliability (most blood tests within 4–6 hours, imaging within 24 hours), alongside physical copies at our Kharghar center.
